title: Processing ICES DATRAS Data for FishGlob
text: FishGlob database global compilation standardized scientific trawl survey data used study large-scale patterns marine fish biodiversity community structure. FishGlob harmonizes data multiple regional monitoring programs standardizing: taxonomic information sampling effort catch metrics (abundance biomass per unit area) dataset integrates numerous long-term fisheries-independent surveys, including several surveys available ICES DATRAS database. ICES DATRAS (Database Trawl Surveys) provides access standardized survey data collected European seas, including haul-level sampling information (HH), length distributions (HL), individual data (CA). DATRASextra package provides tools process raw DATRAS survey data generate outputs compatible FishGlob data structure. vignette demonstrates workflow : download DATRAS survey data harmonize clean_datras raw survey tables standardize species taxonomy estimate swept area biomass generate FishGlob-compatible datasets workflow can applied single species multiple species. illustration, vignette uses mini. example dataset containing 6 species across 4 surveys (BITS, BTS, EVHOE, NS-IBTS): Amblyraja radiata, Hippoglossoides platessoides, Trisopterus esmarkii, Lophius piscatorius, Lepidorhombus whiffiagonis

text: function adds haul-level swept area (SweptArea) door-swept area (DoorsArea) HH table. Missing WingSpread, DoorSpread, Distance values reconstructed using survey-specific prediction models hierarchical fallback rules. implementation follows methodology used FishGlob workflow. Missing WingSpread DoorSpread values predicted internally stored survey-specific models. observed values missing judged implausible, function applies survey-specific corrections fallback prediction rules.
